senses.gloss: kuttumbitti, Kannaḍa; cf. grant of certain towns and kuttum-bittis as aṅuga-jīvita or fief (Ep. Ind., Vol. XVI, pp. 81-83); mentioned along with bhatta-grāma (Sanskrit bhakta-grāma), ‘provision village’ (ibid., Vol. XVIII, p. 193); probably, Sanskrit kuṭumba-vṛtti, grant made for the maintenance of the donee's family.
